g.text: Planned comparisons: training on ERA5 lowers error up to day 6; adding the ERA5-trained prediction as an extra input changes little

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Change in mean absolute error from the ENS-trained model with the same columns, points of capacity (more negative is better). Solid line at zero: same as that model. Blue: the ERA5-trained model alone. Green: the ENS-trained model given the ERA5-trained model's prediction as an extra input. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval. Dashed line at -0.15: a change counts as material only if it is below -0.15, its interval is wholly below zero, and at least 9 of 12 months improve. ERA5: ECMWF's estimate of past weather. ENS: ECMWF's 51-member ensemble weather forecast. Every model on these charts is an XGBoost model given the same weather columns and no calendar or power-history columns. 6 solar farms and 3 wind farms; 53 ENS runs, one every 7 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Intervals come from re-drawing whole months at random and fitting with different random seeds.'
text.tspan: Change in mean absolute error from the ENS-trained model with the same columns, points of capacity (more negative is better). Solid line at zero: same as that model.
Blue: the ERA5-trained model alone. Green: the ENS-trained model given the ERA5-trained model's prediction as an extra input. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval.
Dashed line at -0.15: a change counts as material only if it is below -0.15, its interval is wholly below zero, and at least 9 of 12 months improve.

ERA5: ECMWF's estimate of past weather. ENS: ECMWF's 51-member ensemble weather forecast. Every model on these charts is an XGBoost model given the same weather columns and no calendar or power-history columns.
6 solar farms and 3 wind farms; 53 ENS runs, one every 7 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Intervals come from re-drawing whole months at random and fitting with different random seeds.
